title: Apparel Return Window
text: Apparel products can be requested for return within 7 days of delivery when the item is unused and retains its original tags and packaging.

title: Apparel Return Window
text: Items showing signs of use may be rejected during quality inspection.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Footwear can be requested for return within 7 days of delivery when the product is unused and returned with its original packaging.

title: Footwear Return Window
text: Shoes should not show outdoor wear or damage caused after delivery.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Eligible electronics can be requested for return within 7 days of delivery when the product meets the applicable return conditions.

title: Electronics Return Window
text: Products may be checked for physical damage, missing accessories, or signs of misuse during inspection.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: Eligible home products can generally be requested for return within 7 days of delivery.

title: Home Products Return Window
text: The product should be unused and returned with its original packaging, accessories, and included components.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: For eligible cash-on-delivery returns, the refund is initiated after the returned product passes the required inspection.

title: COD Refund Timeline
text: The refund is processed through the eligible refund method selected during the return process.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: For eligible prepaid orders, the refund is initiated after the returned product completes the required inspection.

title: Prepaid Refund Timeline
text: The amount is then processed back through the applicable original payment or approved refund method.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: Standard delivery estimates are shown for the order based on the destination, seller, inventory location, and delivery service.

title: Standard Delivery SLA
text: The displayed delivery estimate should be treated as the primary expected delivery window for the order.

title: Delayed Delivery
text: If an order passes its displayed delivery estimate, the customer can check the latest tracking status from the order details.

title: Delayed Delivery
text: Delivery delays can occur because of logistics, weather, operational issues, or other circumstances affecting the shipment.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: A reverse pickup can be arranged for an eligible return when pickup service is available for the delivery address.

title: Reverse Pickup Eligibility
text: The returned item must satisfy the applicable return conditions before the pickup request can be completed.

title: Return Inspection
text: Returned products may undergo a quality check before the return is accepted.

title: Return Inspection
text: Missing accessories, physical damage, usage marks, or other violations of the applicable return conditions can result in rejection.

title: Return Request Status
text: Customers can monitor an active return request through the order or return details.

title: Return Request Status
text: The displayed status indicates the latest stage of pickup, inspection, refund processing, or completion.

title: Non-Returnable Conditions
text: Some products may be excluded from return because of their category, condition, hygiene requirements, or other applicable restrictions.

title: Non-Returnable Conditions
text: The product-specific return eligibility shown on the order should be checked before creating a return request.

title: Damaged Product Return
text: A customer receiving a damaged product should report the issue through the applicable order support or return flow.

title: Damaged Product Return
text: The request may require photographs or other information to support the damage claim.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: If the delivered product does not match the ordered product, the customer can raise the issue through the order support or return flow.

title: Wrong Product Received
text: The product may be inspected before the resolution is completed.
